In detail

Falkenhagener Feld is one of Berlin's 143 official Bezirksregionen, part of the Bezirk of Spandau. Polizei Berlin's 2025 Kriminalitätsatlas records a Häufigkeitszahl (HZ) of 6,225 here — total recorded offences per 100,000 registered residents — with 2,681 cases recorded for the year, roughly 0.6× the citywide average, below it. HZ is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy shopping, transit or tourist area can show a higher HZ without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential zone can show a low HZ simply by having few offences relative to its population. This is Wandroz's only rating layer for Berlin so far — a real official police statistic, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data does not distinguish day from night, so both figures shown here are the same.
